note: validateApplication(d) returns { validityClass, feeDueAsPence, missingItemCount, rules } and no flags, so this is a SPLIT engine: the oracle pins detectFlaggedIssues(state) as expected.flaggedIssues with flagsArgs ["state"], mirroring form-app.js's detectFlaggedIssues(state). Classification: any missing data item (required field, VIN or registration-number format, seriously damaged vehicle, unsigned declaration) -> 'incomplete'; else any missing document or fee -> 'needs-supporting-documents'; else 'ready-to-submit'. Fee: V62 25 pounds (waived with a new-keeper slip, or for a V5C not received within 6 weeks); first registration, import, and V627/1 55 pounds. Vehicle age and MOT/type-approval requirements are computed from the application date in the state, so no wall clock is involved.

personas.name: v62-lost-v5c-ready
personas.description: V62 replacement for a lost V5C, 25 pound cheque, signed: ready to submit, with the low lost-V5C flag.

flaggedIssues.description: The V5C was lost, so a replacement is requested with the 25 pound fee.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Post the V62 with a cheque or postal order for 25 pounds payable to DVLA, Swansea. Do not send cash.

personas.name: v62-acquired-with-slip-ready
personas.description: V62 for a vehicle acquired without a V5C, with the new-keeper slip: no fee, ready to submit.

personas.name: v62-not-received-in-window
personas.description: V62 where the V5C has not arrived within 6 weeks: no fee due, ready to submit.

personas.name: v62-acquired-no-slip-no-fee
personas.description: V62 acquired without a V5C and no new-keeper slip: 25 pounds due but nothing enclosed, so it needs documents; entitlement and fee flags.

rules.description: A fee of £25.00 is due but no payment is enclosed.

flaggedIssues.description: No new-keeper slip from the most recent V5C is enclosed, so the 25 pound fee applies and the DVLA may ask for proof that you acquired the vehicle.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Ask the seller for the green new-keeper slip; if you cannot, enclose proof of purchase and the fee.

flaggedIssues.description: A fee of £25.00 is due but no payment is enclosed.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Enclose a cheque or postal order payable to DVLA, Swansea, or pay at a Post Office branch that deals with vehicle tax. Do not send cash.

personas.name: v55-4-new-vehicle-missing-docs
personas.description: New vehicle first registration with no certificate of newness, no type approval, and no payment: needs supporting documents.

rules.description: A new vehicle needs a certificate of newness (or a declaration of newness for an import).
Vehicle approval evidence is needed for a vehicle under 10 years old, unless exempt.
A fee of £55.00 is due but no payment is enclosed.

flaggedIssues.description: Vehicle approval evidence (certificate of conformity, type approval, IVA, or MSVA) is missing for a vehicle under 10 years old.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Enclose the manufacturer certificate of conformity or the approval certificate for the vehicle.

flaggedIssues.description: A fee of £55.00 is due but no payment is enclosed.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Enclose a cheque or postal order payable to DVLA, Swansea, or pay at a Post Office branch that deals with vehicle tax. Do not send cash.

personas.name: v55-4-new-vehicle-ready
personas.description: New vehicle first registration with newness certificate, type approval, and 55 pound cheque: ready to submit.

personas.name: v55-5-used-no-mot
personas.description: Used vehicle 7 years old, no MOT certificate, vehicle approval present, wrong fee amount: needs documents.

rules.description: A valid MOT certificate is needed for a used vehicle over 3 years old (over 4 in Northern Ireland).
The fee due is £55.00 but the amount recorded is different.

flaggedIssues.description: A used vehicle over 3 years old (over 4 in Northern Ireland) needs a current MOT certificate with the first-registration application.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Have the vehicle tested and enclose the MOT certificate.

flaggedIssues.description: The fee due is £55.00 but the amount recorded is £25.00.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Correct the payment so it matches the fee due.

personas.name: v55-5-used-old-exempt-ready
personas.description: Used vehicle 20 years old: type approval exempt, valid MOT, 55 pound postal order: ready to submit.

personas.name: imported-vehicle-nova-missing
personas.description: Imported used vehicle not notified to HMRC through NOVA, with an IVA certificate and MOT: needs documents with a high NOVA flag.

rules.description: HMRC must be told of the vehicle arrival (NOVA) within 14 days; the vehicle is not recorded as notified.

flaggedIssues.description: An imported vehicle must be notified to HMRC through the Notification of Vehicle Arrivals (NOVA) within 14 days of arrival; it is not recorded as notified.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Notify HMRC through NOVA and enter the reference before applying to register the vehicle.

personas.name: imported-vehicle-ready
personas.description: Imported used vehicle with a NOVA reference, IVA, MOT, and fee: ready to submit.

personas.name: kit-vehicle-no-build-evidence
personas.description: Kit vehicle with no build evidence: needs documents with an entitlement flag.

rules.description: A rebuilt or kit vehicle needs receipts and build evidence (for example build plans).

flaggedIssues.description: A rebuilt or kit vehicle needs the build evidence (receipts, build plans) that shows the vehicle is entitled to be registered.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Enclose receipts for the major components and any build plans.

personas.name: seriously-damaged-vehicle
personas.description: Seriously damaged vehicle that cannot be repaired: incomplete (cannot be registered), high flag.

rules.description: A seriously damaged vehicle that cannot be repaired cannot be registered.

flaggedIssues.description: The vehicle is recorded as seriously damaged, meaning it cannot be repaired. The DVLA cannot register a vehicle in that state, and fees paid beforehand are not refunded.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Do not send the application until the vehicle has been repaired and can be registered.

personas.name: bad-vin-and-registration
personas.description: V62 with a VIN containing the letter O and a malformed registration number: incomplete with format flags.

rules.description: The registration number does not match a known Great Britain or Northern Ireland format.
The VIN is not 17 characters of letters (not I, O, Q) and digits, as ISO 3779 requires for a vehicle made from 1981.

flaggedIssues.description: The V5C was destroyed, so a replacement is requested with the 25 pound fee.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Post the V62 with a cheque or postal order for 25 pounds payable to DVLA, Swansea. Do not send cash.

flaggedIssues.description: The VIN is not 17 characters of letters (not I, O, Q) and digits, as ISO 3779 requires for a vehicle made from 1981.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Check the VIN against the plate on the vehicle or the V5C; a mistyped VIN delays the application.

flaggedIssues.description: The registration number does not match a Great Britain or Northern Ireland format.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Check the registration number on the number plate or the V5C.

personas.name: northern-ireland-company-keeper
personas.description: Company keeper at a Northern Ireland address, owner differs, no insurance, no company number: incomplete.

rules.description: A company keeper needs a Companies House registration number.
The owner differs from the keeper but the owner name is missing.
The declaration is not signed.
An insurance certificate or cover note is needed when registering to a Northern Ireland address.

flaggedIssues.description: A Northern Ireland address needs an insurance certificate or cover note with the first-registration application.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Enclose an insurance certificate or cover note naming the vehicle.

flaggedIssues.description: The owner differs from the registered keeper. The keeper named on the V5C is responsible for taxing and insuring the vehicle; the V5C is not proof of ownership.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Enter the owner name and check that the keeper details are right.

flaggedIssues.description: The declaration is not signed, and the DVLA will return an unsigned application.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Sign and date the declaration before posting the application.

personas.name: northern-ireland-no-insurance
personas.description: Individual keeper at a Northern Ireland address with the owner recorded but no insurance certificate: needs documents; keeper-owner and high insurance flags.

rules.description: An insurance certificate or cover note is needed when registering to a Northern Ireland address.

flaggedIssues.description: A Northern Ireland address needs an insurance certificate or cover note with the first-registration application.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Enclose an insurance certificate or cover note naming the vehicle.

flaggedIssues.description: The owner differs from the registered keeper. The keeper named on the V5C is responsible for taxing and insuring the vehicle; the V5C is not proof of ownership.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Check that the keeper details are right and keep proof of the owner.

personas.name: blank-application
personas.description: A blank application: incomplete with every required item missing.

rules.description: The application type (V62, V55/4, V55/5, import, V627/1) is not chosen.
The application date is missing.
The applicant name is missing.
The applicant date of birth is missing.
The applicant address or postcode is missing.
The registered keeper name is missing.
The keeper type (individual, company, organization, trade) is missing.
The vehicle make is missing.
The vehicle model is missing.
The declaration is not signed.

flaggedIssues.description: The declaration is not signed, and the DVLA will return an unsigned application.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Sign and date the declaration before posting the application.

personas.name: v62-no-identity-overpaid
personas.description: V62 acquired without a V5C with a slip enclosed but a fee paid and no identity evidence: needs documents; low overpayment flag. Not insured, so the low insurance flag also fires.

rules.description: Send a photocopy of a photocard driving licence, or copies of one document proving the name and one proving the address.

flaggedIssues.description: Proof of identity is missing. The DVLA asks for a photocopy of a photocard driving licence, or copies of one document proving your name and one proving your address.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Enclose a photocopy of your photocard driving licence, or a passport copy plus a recent utility bill or bank statement.

flaggedIssues.description: The vehicle is not insured. It must be insured before it is used on the road.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Arrange insurance before driving the vehicle.

flaggedIssues.description: No fee is due for this application, but a payment is recorded.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Remove the payment, or check whether the application type is correct.
